failure.cause: A serving probe inherited fsGroup=1000 while mounting the shared snapshot claim. Kubelet changed captured file ownership/permissions. The snapshot content was unchanged, but copy2 propagated the changed log mode into per-Pod scratch.
failure.original_behavior: normal-load fallback completed a valid scientific result

correction.group_access: Remove fsGroup/fsGroupChangePolicy only for selected snapshot Pods; retain group membership using supplementalGroups.
correction.scratch: Copy tiny cache/log into per-Pod shadow, verify the original captured log SHA256, reconstruct its recorded mode/UID/GID, then use the unchanged frozen supervisor. Large checkpoint pages remain read-only on shared storage.
correction.failure_semantics: Missing/changed source log keeps restore preparation unavailable; existing Prefer/Require fallback behavior decides the result.
correction.metadata_source: Original immutable bundle manifest, worker.log: 2802 bytes, SHA256 0fdec95de71579f147a252636551c6a74bcc8f2dfc1a2ee02a0e876e54430a0c, mode0644 uid0 gid0.

real_gpu_result.clock_note: Component durations, not end-to-end cold start. Existing node/image/shared-filesystem cache retained.
real_gpu_result.method: Cloned actual production Pod with exact runtime/mount/security settings; helper applied, one server-mode request window retained. Authorized previously prepared inputs were copied unchanged and both original scientific wrappers executed as UID10001. Not a new full public admission/collector run.

cleanup: All three diagnostic/restore GPU Pods and the two CPU readers were deleted; retained snapshot claim and original contents unchanged. No cloud, quota, driver or production deployment mutation.
